flower_counter.fact: At $0957, decrement $60A9 for a consumed $E5 cell. Nonzero returns to $0784; zero reaches completion handling at $095E and sets bit 1 of $6001.

code_62_counter.fact: When returned E=1, $6065=0 increments $609F; otherwise $60A2 increments and is capped at 3. The handler returns through $0957, so $60A9 decrements on this path too. This audit does not assign heart/letter names.

classifier_59_to_61.fact: $09FE calls this classifier only when the preceding helper returns E=2 or E=3. $3E96 applies mode-dependent bit clears in $609D-$60A1; the classifier buckets are not semantic labels.

skull_consumer.bytes: 06 06 dd 21 a8 61 dd 7e 01 fe 00 28 1c dd 6e 00 dd 66 01 dd e5 c5 cd 2b 3d 36 e5 21 a9 60 34 c1 dd e1 af dd 77 00 dd 77 01 dd 23 dd 23 10 d7 c9
skull_consumer.fact: Loops over six two-byte slots at $61A8-$61B3. For each nonzero pointer, $3D2B resolves the cell, the handler writes $E5, increments $60A9, and clears the record.

map_loader_and_records.fact: $34CF skips the $60A9 increment for class byte $0B, while other counted classes flow to the counter increment. $3F7B selects $61A8 for class $0B, $61A2 for class $0A, and $619C for classes below $0A. Current B5 work RAM has six active red-circle records across $619C/$61A2 and two active $0B skull records in $61A8.

b5_live_overlay_to_source_record_mapping.address_to_map_cell: Little-endian - tile pointers: raw_x=offset mod 32, raw_y=floor(offset/32); ROT270 visible mapping output_x=raw_y-4, output_y=30-raw_x; maze row=output_y-2.

counter_reconciliation.stage_load_counter: $60A9=$73 (115), first observed at frame 546 and stable through the neutral/input test
counter_reconciliation.source_reconciliation: 115 = 109 $E5 cells + six non-$0B tracked red-circle records. The two active $0B skull records are initially excluded; $4005 converts each active skull cell to $E5 and increments $60A9 once. A skull event can therefore add two current targets. This is source/state reconciliation, not proof that $60A9 alone is the complete stage-clear acceptance contract.
counter_reconciliation.remaining_semantics: Codes 0x5A/0x5B/0x60/0x62 route through distinct handlers or classifier buckets, and current source records separate internal classes. Visible red-circle heart-versus-letter roles, required bonus subset, and independent special completion conditions remain unproven.

player_input_owner.rom_owner_range: $05FF-$0653; called from the active main loop at $07AF.
player_input_owner.human_demo_boundary: $605F bit 4 set selects demo pointer $61D8; bit 4 clear selects live controls. With $6065=0 the handler reads $9000; nonzero $6065 selects $9000/$9001 using $9002 bit 5.
player_input_owner.normalization: CPL; AND 0x0F; return for zero; accept only exact one-hot values 1, 2, 4, 8.
player_input_owner.axis_math: $3690-$36C0: D=1 updates $6027 left; D=2 updates $6028 down; D=4 updates $6027 right; D=8 updates $6028 up. Retained B5 RAM/pixel samples map $6027 to pixel x and $6028 to pixel y, within one pixel of animation-origin variation.
player_input_owner.ownership_limit: There is no isolated entry-release input gate in the traced owner. Input is read in the active main loop. A direction observed in the forced spawn corridor is not accepted-input evidence.

phase.name: Part-1 stable free-junction P1 Down versus neutral comparison
phase.predeclared_success_marker: At verified neutral cell (12,18), P1 Down at frames 660-667 traverses the expected east edge to (13,18), with $6028 decreasing by 8 and the player pixel center moving right by 8.
phase.timeout_meaning: The predeclared movement marker was absent within the 60-second phase; this fails the proposed axis mapping and says nothing about game slowness.
phase.outcome: FAILED_AS_DECLARED; input and motion were observed, but in the opposite screen axis and with a 7-count RAM delta.

b6_control_discriminator.decision: The neutral free-node prerequisite passes and the P1 Down press is admitted: $6026 changes, then player RAM/pixel motion starts. The predeclared east/+8-pixel marker fails: motion is south into a legal reciprocal edge with $6028=-7. Reject the ROT270-derived Down-to-east expectation. Retain only the measured P1 Down-to-south result; the second axis and all-family route acceptance remain open.

next_discriminator.scope: One separate ≤60-second perpendicular-axis input test after PM reassessment; no full route in B6.
next_discriminator.phase: Repeat the deterministic entry actions; require $606E=1 and neutral player at (12,18), unchanged RAM for frames 654-659; then press P1 Right on frames 660-667.
next_discriminator.success_marker: From the same node, P1 Right must increase $6027 and carry the exact player-pixel center east across the legal edge into cell (13,18) by frame 668. Record the exact RAM and pixel displacement; no fixed +8 displacement is assumed. Part, $60A9, and bonus counters must remain unchanged. Missing node/baseline/axis marker fails; timeout is not a speed diagnosis.
next_discriminator.after: Only after both axes and all overlay/counter collection requirements are evidenced may a later-part natural route be prepared. It must retain actual Part counter, rate byte, four enemy pixel origins/displacements, all required target-family counters, and death/route progress; maximum capture phase remains 60 seconds.
